audit_scope: Read-only acceptance of FAV_TAKER and UNDER_TAKER returned result.json, AUDIT.json, orders_and_fills.json.gz for the frozen 185-market source. No worker, HFT, native execution, PUBLIC_WINDOW payload, tuning, or rerun was performed.

verification_method.source: Rehashed all stage manifest entries, SOURCE_PARENT runtime file hashes, stage per-market META copies, original released NPZ/META inputs and four official label/provenance files. Compared INPUTS event/meta/label SHA256 values against those bytes and frozen INPUT_AUDIT.
verification_method.results: Rehashed each of 370 result.json, AUDIT.json and orders_and_fills.json.gz. Recomputed order NEW quantity/timestamps from exact stage META window_start_ms; independently summed receipt quantities and price*qty by side and matched result inventory/cost and order-sequence filled_qty. Compared result.win with official stage LABELS and verified those against local official provenance.
verification_method.privacy: Scanned parsed keys and string values in the 1,110 requested per-arm JSON payloads for wallet/address/account/transaction/order hashes, secret/token-like fields, and address/hash/email/token-shaped values. Synthetic order_sequence fields are allowed and only open unresolved sequences are emitted.
verification_method.uncertainty: Preserved each raw AUDIT status, EOF_terminal_gate, owner_status and unresolved count. Any unresolved/right-censored/UNKNOWN record remains UNKNOWN_EOF, never promoted to PASS.

scope.feed_selection_per_input_audit: 70 feed IDs only; no event values inspected for selection
